column1: # Spots the managed decoder finds on the recorded slots that the native wsprd
# missed (it gained them with the drift-search fix, zeus-88xj.5). Each was
# checked by hand on wspr.live on 2026-09-26, the day the slots were recorded:
# the station was spotted by other receivers on that band in that very slot.
# This file is the frozen record of that check — the tests only read it and
# never go to the network (wspr.live keeps spots for a limited time only).
# Columns: slot file, message, reporters, spotted as.
